scope: Read-only source review and unauthenticated public GET. No environment values, account access, order creation, payment, delivery, dashboard or external event collection tested.

conclusions.utmUrlCompatibility: Both tested public tutorial URLs return 200 with all four UTM query parameters unchanged; canonical omits query. This proves URL compatibility only.
conclusions.utmContent: Not part of GoalAttribution/UTM_KEYS/SAFE_ATTRIBUTION_QUERY_KEYS; discarded from saved custom attribution including saved landing URL. A separately configured GA4 may interpret it, but configuration, collection and reports were not verified.
conclusions.consent: Optional attribution reads/writes and third-party analytics are gated by explicit consent. Sensitive order/checkout/admin paths suppress analytics loader. Absence of external analytics script tags in server HTML does not prove scripts cannot load after consent.
frontendEvents: purchase_success (when observed order status is delivered)
conclusions.eventEvidenceLevel: Event names and callers verified in source. No client runtime event dispatch, vendor receipt, real purchase, payment confirmation or delivery was exercised. view_checkout/view_order_query are declared but sensitive-path loader is disabled; do not count declarations as runtime coverage.
conclusions.directOrderAttributionGap: Product form sends nested attribution and consent fields, but validateDirectCheckoutBody returns only email, quantity, productId, skuId, orderPassword, channelType. requestGuestCheckout create-and-pay payload has no attribution/consent fields. Ops notification reads top-level body.utm_* which this form does not send. Thus custom UTM -> durable order -> paid/delivered linkage is not established by this code.
conclusions.purchaseEventGap: purchase_success is a client observation of delivered order with per-session deduplication. It is not a payment webhook, globally idempotent backend conversion or independently verified revenue metric.
conclusions.agentCheckout: Agent form sends nested attribution to a separate endpoint not implemented in the reviewed App Router. No external backend order persistence contract was examined.

noWebsiteChangeRequired: Use ordinary HTTPS task links to allowlisted public site paths with source=github, medium=referral, campaign and optional content tags.
Store stable link IDs, topic IDs, target site, owner path, campaign and observation date in public manifest; exclude all customer/order/credential data.
If topic differentiation must survive existing custom attribution, encode topic/site in utm_campaign (ASCII letters/digits/._~- and <=160 characters) or use distinct landing paths.
Do not call all funnel stages measured or claim payment/delivery attribution is complete.
GitHub Markdown cannot execute client-side click handlers; GitHub outbound-click totals are not provided by the repository README itself.
guideImplementationContract.schemaBoundary: A public JSON manifest may record URLs/topic/CTA identity/verification state. Do not publish internal attribution IDs, consent credentials, API keys, order IDs, buyer emails or vendor dashboard identifiers.
futureWork: Verify deployed analytics consent flow and vendor event receipt with scoped consent and no real purchases.
Define backend consent-aware attribution persistence contract and idempotent paid/delivered conversion sources before building revenue attribution.
Define denominators, timezone, refund handling and deduplication separately for landing, click, order creation, payment and delivery.
